relations.evidence: sumatijaya jitāmitra malle sanaśva pustaka dayakā || bhāgirāmayāvelasa
sumatijaya jitāmitra malle sanaśva pustaka dayakā || bhāgirāmayāvelasa

notes: The verses preceding the colophon invoke the nine Nātha masters (Matsyendranātha, Gorakṣa, etc.). Jitāmitramalla was the King of Bhaktapur (r. 1673–1696 CE). Newari 'pustaka dayakā' indicates he caused the manuscript to be prepared. 'bhāgirāmayāvelasa' is taken as referring to the scribe Bhāgīrāma.
